purpose: Classify whether a new MorroWise component may be treated as part of the live system before it is referenced by dashboards, schedulers, runners, or workflows.

admission_states.accepted: The component has enough loop contract, boundary, degraded states, and verifier evidence to be referenced as live-system capability.
admission_states.prototype: The component may exist for exploration, but must not be described as live or used as required workflow infrastructure.
admission_states.blocked: The component is missing required evidence or safety boundary and must not be connected to MorroWise.
admission_states.static_display: The component is display-only; it may be shown as static/manual evidence but cannot claim feedback-loop behavior.

gate_rules.meaning: Accepted components must define trigger, source_of_truth, process, output, surface, next_action, feedback_loop, write_boundary, degraded_states, and verifier.
A component without feedback_loop cannot be accepted; it must be prototype or static_display.
A component must explicitly state what it cannot write or execute. Unknown write boundary defaults to blocked.
A component without a repeatable verifier cannot be accepted into MorroWise.
Components that can commit, push, send messages, sync external systems, mutate task state, or touch schedules must route through approval policy or worktree-commit gate.

components.loop_role: Detect unfinished local git work, connect it to candidate MC task anchors, and route the next step to commit planning gate.
next_action: If task anchor exists, enter commit cleanup planning gate.
If task anchor is missing or unclear, create or select MC task before commit planning.
If repo needs reconcile, resolve branch/reconcile state before commit planning.
feedback_loop: worktree-commit updates task state or writes task-event outbox after Vincent-confirmed commit
subsequent commit-attention sweep reflects cleaner repo state or remaining open loops

components.loop_role: Turn commit-attention output into a scoped commit cleanup plan before any worktree-commit action is allowed.
trigger: commit-attention summary reports repos needing attention
Vincent asks to plan commit cleanup
process: Agent work-anchor preflight and scoped dirty-tree review
output: commit cleanup plan in current Agent thread
next_action: Blocked repos stop with reason and next required step.
Allowed repos produce grouped commit plan for Vincent confirmation.
Confirmed groups hand off to worktree-commit.
feedback_loop: worktree-commit outcome updates MC task state or task-event outbox
next commit-attention sweep verifies whether repo attention cleared

allowed: read generated commit-attention and worktree status
run git status and git diff --stat
